title: guizotia jacksonii
intro: Guizotia jacksonii, commonly known as the wild sesame or brown sesame, is a plant species native to the Himalayan region. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as arthritis and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Guizotia jacksonii include its ability to stimulate digestion and relieve respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Guizotia jacksonii seeds include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
